title: Product of tribe Fourier expectations
statement: For natural numbers $w,s$ and a set $T$ of coordinates in the product of an $s$-element index set and a $w$-element index set, let $k$ be the number of indices whose corresponding part of $T$ is nonempty. The product over all $s$ indices of the uniform-cube expectation of $(1+	ext{AND}(y))$ times the monomial indexed by that part of $T$ equals $2^s(1-2^{-w})^{s-k}(2^{-w})^k(-1)^{|T|+k}$, where the AND function is $-1$ exactly when every coordinate is $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a finite set of coordinates indexed by Fin (s w)
